Keywords: House of Percy Azure Lion Rampant
RagShortTexts: The House of Percy guarded the Northumbrian border from Alnwick, holding the Scottish frontier.

Variants.Content: Guarding the barren marches of Northumberland, the House of Percy bore a blue lion rampant on gold. Centered upon Alnwick Castle, the Percys operated autonomous northern frontier defenses against Scottish incursions, hardened by constant border skirmishes along the River Tweed.
Exercising Marcher liberties, Percy wardens enforced immediate cross-border reprisal raids, largely detached from southern court intrigues in Westminster.
Sub-zero Northumbrian winds whistle through Alnwick arrow-slits. Sentries sleep in mail hauberks, ready to mount warhorses at the first beacon flare.
